sessions.phase_label: Initial primary and secondary CAD layer delivery

requirements.title: Primary CAD Layer
requirements.definition: Produce and revise the Primary layer for the CHA2205 Charger Summit East CAD deliverable according to the client-provided materials.
requirements.boundary_note: The Primary layer is separate from the Secondary layer because the client supplies edits for each independently.

requirements.title: Secondary CAD Layer
requirements.definition: Produce and revise the Secondary layer for the CHA2205 Charger Summit East CAD deliverable according to the client-provided materials.
requirements.boundary_note: The Secondary layer is independently revisable and therefore remains separate from the Primary layer.

unresolved_candidates.description: The referenced Primary materials and revision attachments are unavailable in the supplied text, so the layers' detailed geometry and requested edit criteria cannot be recovered.
